verdict.rationale: Namecheap has an API, so scoped agent credentials are a fair axis for this product. The evidence shows only that calls require an APIUser parameter and a client IP, and nothing documents issuing scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent keys. The Terraform per-record resource pattern organizes resources and does not restrict what a credential can do, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
